head: 1b1a32c4d1d7ec81a043f40ffe9a6d408c89d301
notes: Foundry invariant runner executed with default config (256 runs / 500 calls per invariant). Medusa/Echidna runs deferred: the highest-signal property already failed under forge with a clean 5-step shrunk counterexample, so further fuzzers would add noise rather than coverage at this stage.

invariants.name: invariant_no_pending_underflow_for_actors
invariants.description: For any reachable state, pendingPhUSD(user) and pendingStable(user) must not revert with arithmetic underflow for any actor with a non-zero stake. (Mirrors the underflow site inside _claimRewards, so any claim() call would also revert.)

invariants.name: invariant_accumulators_monotonic
invariants.description: accStablePerShare and accPhUSDPerShare are non-decreasing across all reachable states.

invariants.name: invariant_lastRewardTime_monotonic
invariants.description: lastRewardTime is non-decreasing across all reachable states.

invariants.name: invariant_totalStaked_matches_sum
invariants.description: totalStaked == sum(userInfo[u].amount) over all fuzz actors.

invariants.name: invariant_principal_conservation
invariants.description: Cumulative principal withdrawn via withdraw + pauseWithdraw (measured as totalStaked decrements) never exceeds cumulative principal staked. APY-minted phUSD is paid via phUSD.mint() direct-to-user and is excluded from this identity.
invariants.notes: Initial implementation incorrectly conflated reward-mint receipts with principal-out. Corrected to measure principal-out via totalStaked decrements. Now PASS.

invariants.name: invariant_rewardBalance_bounded_by_real
invariants.description: Internal rewardBalance accounting never exceeds rewardToken.balanceOf(phlimbo). (Standard ERC20 reward token assumed.)
